A university registrar's office maintains data about the following entities: (a) courses, with attributes including number, title, credits, syllabus, and prerequisites; (b) course offerings, is to model year, semester, section number, timings, and classroom; (c) students, with attributes student-id, name, and program; (d) instructors, with attributes identification number, name, department, qualifications and title.
